blocks.text: LOS ANGELES, United States — The San Antonio Spurs were forced to dig deep before defeating the Utah Jazz 110-102 to clinch their 12th straight victory on Sunday as the Los Angeles Lakers extended their winning streak to eight games. Utah, languishing at the bottom of the Western Conference with only one win all season, had threatened to pull off a huge upset after leading by five points midway through the fourth quarter.
